location_fine: village yard under a grape trellis
key_props: burlap sack carried over the shoulder
visual_synopsis: A blond mustachioed villager in a camouflage jacket hauls a bulging sack over his shoulder out of a sunny village yard while an old woman in a bright floral housecoat (a male actor in a grey wig and glasses) blocks him at the trellis walkway and argues with him at length, hands on hips. Cutaways show a hunting shotgun leaning against the whitewashed wall and the man trudging off through the green orchard with the sack.
